items.summary: Update backend admin-role assignment so that the user whose in-game username is exactly "@Admin" (after trimming leading/trailing spaces) is granted the admin role in the access control system when they save their profile (both on initial profile creation and on subsequent profile updates).

Fix backend logic so that saving a new user profile does not automatically grant admin privileges to every new user; admin auto-grant should only apply to the intended bootstrap policy (first 5 profiles) and the special "@Admin" username.
